description: Total token usage and cost for a period, split by client (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex). Tokens are broken out into input / output / cache-read / cache-write / reasoning, because cache tokens typically dwarf input and a single blended total is misleading. Reported cost (from OpenCode) and estimated cost (computed for Claude Code and Codex, which record none) are always listed separately and must not be summed. Also reports the cache hit rate and reads-per-write, which are what say whether the cache is paying for itself -- the raw cache counts alone cannot.

client.description: Restrict to these clients (a single id also works).

compare.description: Also report the equally long window just before this one, with the delta. Needs a fixed-length period (days, today, or since AND until); an open-ended one is rejected.

days.description: Look back this many days, counted from local midnight. Omit for all time.

includeSubagents.description: Include subagent turns. Default true: they are real spend.

models.description: Restrict to these model ids, as recorded (see model_usage).

projectPaths.description: Restrict to these projects: absolute working directories, matched exactly (see project_usage). A path matching nothing is reported, not answered as empty.

today.description: Restrict to today, in local time.
